errors.description: The stated mark coordinates do not create the listed binary interval lengths. The marks should be the cumulative sums \((2^j-1)\delta\), not \(2^j\delta\). This is a minor, straightforwardly repairable error because the preceding sentence already specifies the intended partition.
errors.quote: Thus his marks are \(2^j\delta\) for \(1\le j\le n\), all distinct and strictly inside the stick.

parsed.notes: Apart from this coordinate error, the drafting lemma, refinement lemma, and matching upper and lower bounds form a coherent and essentially complete proof.
